insights: Home ground advantage is consistent with the database distribution of 1.50 home goals vs 1.14 away goals across 216,909 fixtures.

half_time_result.summary: Fully Connected MLP Neural Network trained on 217,066 historical fixtures to predict half-time match outcomes based on early match state statistics and team parameters.

insights: Away Shots on Target (AST) and Away Total Shots (AS) heavily influence the probability of a home clean sheet, driving over 35% of total predictive weight.

clean_sheet.summary: Multi-Layer Perceptron neural network calibrated on 217,063 historical fixtures to predict Home Team Clean Sheet occurrence using match statistics and team variables.

insights: Referee historic card issuance rate ('referee_cards_avg') proved to be the single strongest predictor for exceeding the 3.5 card threshold across the 217,066 dataset fixtures.

Because overall match baseline averages only 2.26 cards and 30.8% of games exceed 3.5 cards, combining team foul averages with live in-play yellow cards significantly reduced false positive classification error.
